Name: Knights Helmet
Author: Gabbemaster
Description:
Gabbemasters Knights Helmet for Json Assets - Version 1.0.0
Adds a Knights Helmet, available for purchase from the Hat Mouse.

:: Required Mods::
SMAPI (https://smapi.io/)
Json Assets (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)

:: What This Mod Adds::
A knights helmet, available for purchase from the Hat Mouse.

:: Installation Instructions::
1. Download and install the latest version of SMAPI
2. Download and install the latest version of Json Assets
3. Copy the '[JA] Knights Helmet' folder to Mods
4. You're done! Run the game.

:: Contact Info::
Post a comment on the Nexus page for this mod
